The bundled pdf.js contains pdf-lib 1.17.1 and @pdf-lib/fontkit 1.1.1,
including their dependencies. Legal comments generated by esbuild are retained
in the bundle. The pdf-lib licence is reproduced below. @pdf-lib/fontkit declares MIT in its package metadata and README; its published package and official repository contain no separate licence file.
@pdf-lib/fontkit fork author: Andrew Dillon. Original fontkit author: Devon Govett.
